name: Entre a Gente
source:
A lot can happen in six years. You can... move to a new city, run away from your past, regret your actions... oh! And, who knows, maybe take up some hobbies too.

But what would happen if you went back to your home town and the first person you met was your ex-boyfriend? Nothing much, after all, the only thing you'll do is catch up on your conversations.

[From [url=https://igor-panthera.itch.io/entre-a-gente]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
六年内可以发生很多事情。你可以…搬到一个新的城市，逃离你的过去，后悔你的行为…哦！而且，谁知道呢，也许还能培养一些爱好。

但如果你回到家乡，第一个见到的人是你的前男友，会发生什么？毕竟，没什么太多，你唯一要做的就是继续谈话。

[来自[url=https://igor-panthera.itch.io/entre-a-gente]Itch.io[/url]]
